name: 8-Clip Daily Vlog
summary: Builds an editable eight-clip daily vlog Draft from one project footage folder, with an animated yellow title, transitions and bundled audio.

compatibility.selects: Development build only. Released-version compatibility is unverified. Windows: no shell command on the build path; a Windows pass on the Staging build is pending.

inputs.label: Opening clip
inputs.hint: The first shot, under the animated title.
inputs.query: morning or opening moment of the day

inputs.label: Clips
inputs.hint: Pick at least seven distinct clips other than Opening; Opening and duplicate picks are excluded. Seven clips replay Opening before the closing shot. With eight or nine, the first eight distinct clips are used in order; the ninth is not used.

prepare: An opening clip of at least 4.3 seconds, the rest at least 2.6
